text.en:
- Expedite Service Fees, Other Service And/Or
Applicable Fees. Over and above the regular fees for the processing of its
consular services, including passport processing, and other Department services,
the DA is authorized to charge and collect Expedite Service Fees requiring
issuance beyond regular office hours or earlier than the normal processing
period; and other fees to cover the use of technologies to further expedite these
services; and other applicable fees in relation to such services. The DA shall set
such Expedite Service Fees, other service and/or applicable fees, respectively, in
an amount not more than the DA's regular fees for its consular services,
including passport processing, and other Department services.

- Proceeds From Expedite Service Fees, Other
Service And/Or Applicable Fees. The revenues collected or receipts of any
kind from the collection of Expedite Service Fees, other service and/or applicable
fees by the DA under Section 1 shall accrue to the DFA Provident Fund,
beginning 01 March 2010, and be used exclusively by the DA for the operation
of the Fund in favor and/or for the benefit of all its employees.

- Effectivity. This Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 29th day of June
Our Lord, Two Thousand and Ten.
